power.method: High PoE (60 W NPD-6001B or 95 W NPD-9501A/-E midspan) or 21-30 VAC

features: Open camera platform (OC) driven by OSSA / Security & Safety Things app store
AI-based traffic detection for traffic monitoring
High Dynamic Range 120 dB (106 dB per IEC 62676-5)
Integrated window wiper and defroster (enhanced model)
Pan 360 continuous, tilt 290; upright / inverted / canted mounting
IP66 / IP68 / Type 6P, IK10 anodized cast-aluminum housing
dimensions_mm: 287.93 x 400.34 x 210.65 (W x H x D, upright, without illuminator)
release_notes: Specs per official Bosch datasheet (MIC_7602_Z30WR_OC_Data_sheet_enUS_89031170571.pdf, V6 2021). -OC = open camera platform variant with AI-based traffic detection (distinct SKU from MIC-7602-Z30WR). White (RAL 9010), enhanced model with defroster; "available in specific regions only". Power 40 W typical without illuminator (70 W typical with the optional illuminator accessory). IP68 requires installation on a MIC-DCA or MIC wall mount with MIC-SCA. No integrated IR; night vision depends on the optional illuminator. Memory card capacity not stated.

frigate.notes: Bosch official RTSP scheme: /?inst=1 main, /?inst=2 sub (per Bosch 'RTSP usage with Bosch Video IP Devices'). Default admin user is 'service' (no factory default password — set one first). ONVIF Profile S/G (T/M on INTEOX). Not individually bench-tested.

home_assistant.notes: Generic ONVIF integration; Bosch CPP cameras are ONVIF Profile S/G compliant. Use the 'service' account.

blue_iris.notes: Bosch — use the ONVIF/RTSP (or 'Bosch') profile; default admin user is 'service'.
